controls.title: Web: non-text content has a text alternative
controls.evidenceExpectation: Manual audit record (tester, method, pages/components, date, result) supported by automated scan output.

controls.title: Web: information, structure and relationships are programmatically determinable
controls.evidenceExpectation: Manual audit against representative templates plus assistive-technology check.

controls.title: Web: text contrast is at least 4.5:1 (3:1 for large text)
controls.evidenceExpectation: Contrast measurements for the site palette plus automated scan output.

controls.title: Web: all functionality is operable by keyboard
controls.evidenceExpectation: Keyboard-only walkthrough notes for each key flow, with tester and date.

controls.title: Web: keyboard focus indicator is visible
controls.evidenceExpectation: Screenshots/notes of the focus indicator across components.

controls.title: Web: labels or instructions are provided for user input
controls.evidenceExpectation: Form review record covering every input in scope.

controls.title: Web: name, role and value are exposed to assistive technology
controls.evidenceExpectation: Screen-reader test notes for interactive components.

controls.title: Web: focus is not entirely hidden by author content
controls.evidenceExpectation: Keyboard walkthrough confirming the focused element is at least partially visible.

controls.title: Web: interactive targets are at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels (with exceptions)
controls.evidenceExpectation: Measurement record for interactive targets, noting spacing/inline exceptions.

controls.title: Downloadable documents: non-text content has a text alternative
controls.evidenceExpectation: Per-document conformance check output (e.g. PAC, Ace) plus manual review.

controls.title: Mobile app: non-text content has a text alternative
controls.evidenceExpectation: Platform accessibility-inspector output plus screen-reader test notes with build version.

controls.title: Mobile app: exposes the accessibility services of the platform
controls.evidenceExpectation: TalkBack / VoiceOver test notes confirming platform accessibility APIs are used.

controls.title: Closed-functionality terminal: operable without vision
controls.evidenceExpectation: Test report against clause 5.1.3.1 for the model/firmware, with method and date.

controls.title: Terminal: privacy is preserved when using accessibility features
controls.evidenceExpectation: Test report covering private listening / masked display for the accessibility mode.

controls.title: Self-service terminal: tactile and/or audio output is provided
controls.evidenceExpectation: Test report and photographs of the tactile keypad / audio jack / speech output.

controls.title: Support services communicate using accessible means
controls.evidenceExpectation: The published support channels captured as an immutable document, showing an accessible option.

controls.title: The service is usable by a person with no vision (functional-performance outcome)
controls.evidenceExpectation: A named approver's attestation referencing the underlying success-criterion evidence.

controls.title: A publicly available explanation of how the service meets the accessibility requirements
controls.evidenceExpectation: The published statement captured with its URL and retrieval date; must cover known limitations.

controls.title: The accessibility information itself is provided in an accessible format
controls.evidenceExpectation: Conformance check of the statement page/document itself.

controls.title: A completed, documented disproportionate-burden assessment where burden is claimed
controls.evidenceExpectation: The signed, dated assessment applying the Annex VI criteria, listing the requirements it covers and its review date.
